Persist independently verified, full-position keyed subproofs and resumable conditional worklists

reference.proofTrust: No external winner, score, file-existence or move-table claim is accepted as a certificate

verifiedCache.admission: Every certificate is independently checked on insert and reload
verifiedCache.scope: Conditional subpositions under candidate attacking choices; not a percentage of empty-board coverage

regressionsCovered: Missing, occupied, terminal and malformed external hint records are rejected
Forged persistent certificates are rejected and symmetry mappings are checked
Completed roots leave no pending conditional tasks
Zero remaining depth does not consume the task-attempt allowance
Repeated work rounds rotate the cursor and accept an increased root attack depth
Zero budgets, cancellation and complete small endgames do not manufacture wins

limitations: Empty board remains unknown; browser opponent is still the existing TypeScript engine
Only a small public data sample was imported, not the full external corpus
Guided search remains selective; dependency planning and quiet move width have finite budgets
Worklists are conditional and may be truncated; solved jobs alone do not prove their root
Work resumes tasks using verified subproofs, not a saved recursive stack; a new DFPN graph is built for each task attempt
DFPN currently retains the shared arena; no speed or memory improvement has been established
Guided work counts and DFPN edge expansion budgets are different units
Data loading, cache verification, final proof verification and IO may exceed the search stop budget
Cache updates are atomic for one writer; capacity is bounded and there is no eviction or concurrent-writer merge
